key_findings: Naringin dose-dependently reduced prostate inflammation and pelvic pain in EAP mice by activating PPARγ and suppressing NF-κB/NLRP3 inflammasome and oxidative stress.
PPARγ inhibitor GW9662 reversed the anti-inflammatory, antioxidant and anti-allodynic effects of naringin in vivo and in RAW 264.7 macrophages.
